resetDialog.title: Reset all settings?
resetDialog.description: Every preference below goes back to its default. This cannot be undone.

general.startOnBootDesc: Start automatically when you sign in
general.startupPageDesc: Page to show when you enter This Computer after launching the app
general.minimizeToTrayDesc: Keep running in the tray after the window is closed
general.gpuAccelerationDesc: Turn off and restart if the UI flickers or renders incorrectly
general.restartGroupDesc: GPU acceleration changes take effect once $t(common.appName) restarts.

restartDialog.title: Restart $t(common.appName)?
restartDialog.description: The app closes and opens again. Running agents are stopped, and only come back on their own if auto-start is on.

appearance.accentDesc: Used for buttons, selection and links
appearance.scaleDesc: Scales text and spacing together, applied instantly
appearance.skinDesc: Combines with either light or dark, applied instantly
appearance.animationsDesc: Turning them off lowers resource use
appearance.highContrastDesc: Makes text and controls easier to read
appearance.accentLocked: The {{skin}} style ships its own accent colour, so this is fixed

default.name: Default
default.desc: $t(common.appName)’s native look — soft borders and shadows

openagents.name: $t(common.brandName)
openagents.desc: Bold frames, hard shadows and Inter

agents.autoStartDesc: Start every configured agent once $t(common.appName) opens

notifications.enableDesc: Surface system-level alerts for important events
notifications.soundDesc: Play a chime when a notification fires
notifications.quietGroupDesc: No desktop alerts during this window; messages still land in the notification centre.

network.downloadRegionDesc: Applies to Node.js, runtime and agent downloads
network.workspaceUrlDesc: Optional self-hosted workspace server. Leave empty to use $t(common.brandName)-hosted workspaces.
network.httpProxyDesc: Used for outbound HTTP by agents and $t(common.appName)
network.noProxyDesc: Comma-separated hosts that skip the proxy
network.note: Proxy settings are stored in the $t(common.appName) config and reach running agents after a restart.

data.backupGroupDesc: Settings export as a JSON file you can import on another machine.
data.exportSettingsDesc: Save every current setting to a JSON file
data.importSettingsDesc: Restore from a JSON file; matching keys are overwritten
data.resetSettingsDesc: Back to defaults. Agents and workspace data are left alone
data.localGroupDesc: Cached files and interface state this app keeps on your computer. Agents, workspaces and settings are not affected.
data.clearCacheDesc: Empty the cached web pages, icons and images. Safe — they are re-fetched as needed
data.resetLocalDesc: Theme, accent, skin, text size, sidebar and dismissed notices go back to defaults

language.displayLanguageDesc: Language used across the $t(common.appName) interface, applied instantly

updates.autoUpdateDesc: Download new versions in the background and prompt you to restart. With this off you are still told about new versions, but download them yourself
updates.checkHint: Checking never installs anything without asking you first.
updates.bannerReady: Version {{version}} is downloaded and ready to install
updates.installFailedDesc: v{{version}} was downloaded but the installer didn't replace the app — still on v{{current}}. Install it manually from the download page.
updates.installerDidNotStart: the installer wouldn't start on this machine

runtime.openLogsDesc: Reveal the $t(common.appName) log directory in your file manager
runtime.copyDiagnosticsDesc: Copy a version and environment summary to attach to a bug report
runtime.diagnosticsCopyFailed: Copy failed — please note the details manually

about.tagline: $t(common.brandName) Desktop · your workspace and PAI Counselor, in a native window
about.licenseFileDesc: Read the full license on GitHub

localResetDialog.title: Reset appearance and interface state?
localResetDialog.description: The window repaints immediately. Nothing installed or configured is touched.

affected.layout: Sidebar state and the tab the app opens on
affected.history: Command palette history and dismissed update notices
affected.marketplace: Agent Marketplace view, sort and filters

kept.settings: Everything in the other settings modules

privacy.policyDesc: Learn how Placement AI handles account and product data.
privacy.localGroupDesc: Cached files and interface preferences stored on this computer. Your account and workspace are not deleted.
privacy.clearCacheDesc: Remove cached pages, icons and images. They are downloaded again when needed.
privacy.resetLocalDesc: Reset theme, text size, sidebar state and dismissed notices.
